vetSays.line: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunback: Fight from its shadow side. When it arches, move to its SHADOW side — between it and the sun — and don't stand still. The lunge goes where you WERE, and the glare can't touch you from the shade. Strike while it's recharging the scales. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader White Noise (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader White Noise falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader White Noise!

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Vanessa, Aaliyah, Fatima, Caleb and Nino met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Vanessa, Aaliyah, Fatima, Caleb, Nino are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Static Kite: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Sanjay, Joaquín, Fatima, Caleb and Nino met them at the door — 5 put down. Fatima, Caleb, Nino are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big-Eyes: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Vanessa, Sanjay, Aaliyah, Joaquín and Gugu met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Vanessa, Aaliyah, Joaquín, Gugu are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Heckler: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Chorus Line: Dance on the downbeat. The kick only lands on beat 4 of the 4/4 count. Dance and it catches air — but dancing is your whole turn. (At the fire, Theo told Liam, Vanessa, Aaliyah, and 5 more how it moves — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Dustboar: Step OFF the lane — and hold your breath. When it paws the earth, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back — and cover your mouth. The dust blinds it too; it charges where you WERE. Wait for the cough, then strike. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Theo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Union Rep: Kill the rep first. It does not fight, it ORGANIZES — kill the rep before WALKOUT or the stomp lands as one. First blood on the rep, every time. Every ally it rallies hits +3 harder. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aaliyah just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
✨ Ability gained: Cold-Blooded (L1). You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Grief Counselor: Sidestep the charge. Break line of sight during the mirror beat and the charge dies unspent — or sidestep: it can't turn mid-charge. Don't look at the reflection. Look at its feet — they tell you where it's going.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Performance Review: Dodge unpredictably. It grades your dodges aloud — so stop giving it the same dodge twice. Move two rounds running, never the same way, and its lock breaks. Unpredictability is the only passing grade.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Anaconda Empress: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Big Beast: Do something you have never done. It only knows your past — every move you ever made, worn like your face. Do something you have never done and it has nothing to wear. Novelty is literally the weapon; repetition is the uniform it dresses you in. (At the fire, Efya told Caleb, Aaliyah and Fatima how it moves — the village pieced it together.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Efya just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Efya met them at the door — 1 put down. Efya is hurt.
